question_or_proposition: Under the prohibition that there shall be no discharge of floating solids or visible foam in other than trace amounts, what constitutes 'trace amounts' of floating solids or visible foam such that a discharge is permitted rather than prohibited?
required_context: Part I.A floating solids and visible foam effluent limitation
Any permit definitions or compliance evaluation provisions for qualitative or visual effluent standards
Available reported observations or non-numeric results for floating solids or visible foam, if any
notes: The nominated clause pairs a categorical prohibition with a 'trace amounts' exception. Resolving what counts as trace affects whether an enforceable limit is exceeded (Purpose A) and how non-numeric or ambiguous foam/solids evidence is classified versus unresolved (Purpose C). No numeric limit is stated in the span; the obligation is bounded to the trace-exception semantics.
